notes.title: [Patch Note #4] Bug Fixes & UI Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]1. System Improvement[/h2]
[list]
[*] The speed of the algorithm that calculates revenue has been doubled.
[*] A system message will be displayed when calculating revenue by E train to avoid confusion with screen freezes.
[*] Detailed rules are added in the Tutorial.
[*] Now UI that includes stock share and related income will be displayed when purchasing stocks and calculating income.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/299302f7ad224a1e40eeb043af2a80cd68ad58da.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/05e6794b0605e6bbebabf5118044641eea51ffce.png[/img]
[/list]


[h2]2. Bug Fixes[/h2]
-System
[*] Fixed the issue when trains could not be acquired from other companies in the situation of forced train purchase.
[*] Fixed the issue when the controlling shareholder's rights were transferred in the situation of forced purchase of trains by AI.
[*] Fixed the issue when you could participate in the IPO even if your stock holdings reached the maximum.

-Asset Cards
[*] Fixed the issue related to the function of the 'Defector' card.
[*] Fixed the issue that the 'Refugee' card did provide any money to its owner.
[*] Fixed the issue that the effect was not activated even when using the 'Outer Station
Construction' card.



[h2]3. UI Improvement[/h2]
[list]
[*] The range of the pass button has been modified.
[*] The income display of Northern sea and continent tiles is shown to the green era.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/a5c8bb4e74c85d61d9d2dae5dadd0656fc5029d8.png[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: [Patch Note #2] AI (beta) & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]1. AI(beta)[/h1]
Now you can add AI players in local & online play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/44cf32836a3960aa1617ec3482b7c450b4d06969.gif[/img]

[h3]Local[/h3]
In the waiting room, set the number of players.
Click + or - button to change a local player into an AI player or return it to a local player.

[h3]Online[/h3]
Click + or - button to add an AI player or delete it.

[h2]2. 'Defector' UI[/h2]
Now UI for 'Defector' is displayed when the 'Defector' asset card is activated after the Korean War.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/90cd76dfae6af9cd45800fce3588f80b8c9ccec7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/08886ea2ef47a3a4be043a9e53855fd71ab7b661.png[/img]


[h2]3. Bug Report[/h2]
When you find any significant issue during the play, it's more efficient to fix it if you provide us with play data. We've made the report button on the upper side of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/b957101748b4f84d228a5647ad508fbccb66fb57.png[/img]

When you access the report screen and click the 'save' button.
[b]2 player log files[/b] will be created on your desktop. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/b847e868a776576372204a6b112bfd520a2aa22c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/3ab78e1e7fc74841052d690609b60b23179a3dc3.png[/img]

Send us those files by [url=https://discord.gg/e5QxVhDtq6]bug report channel of Discord[/url].
We'll check the issue and fix it as soon as possible.ːsteamhappyː

[h3]Bug Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Revenue auto calculating algorithm has been improved.
[*] Description of asset cards that did not clearly explain its effect has been improved.
[*] Fixed a bug that "Analyst" asset card sometimes made stock price jump triple times.
[*] Fixed a bug that buying stock from a bank funds company. 
[/list]

notes.title: 18Korea has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/03ef6dfcdee619e11c10b9555c81bab712f9686d.png[/img]

Hi, 18Korea has been released on Steam.

There may still be shortcomings, but we will continue to provide you with a better playing experience through continuous maintenance and updates.


[h1]Functions Supported[/h1]
[list]
[h3][*] Local 2-5 player multiplay [/h3]
 - You can enjoy multiplay with 2-5 players using one device.
 Or, you can play with multiple devices with the help of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]Steam Remote Play[/url][/b].


[h3][*] Online 2-5 player multi-play [/h3]
 - You can enjoy online 2-5 player multiplay.
   After the host creates a room, you can enter by sharing the created room number.
 - You can save your play, load it, and play it again. 
After the host creates a room, you can continue with automatically saved data, or data saved by the host, through “Continue” button.
 [i]* When loading saved data, the player information of participating players : each player's nickname and total number of players, must match the player information from the previous play. [/i]

[/list]
[h1]To be updated[/h1]
[list]
[h3][*] Calligraphic version of company logo [/h3]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/0b774158ab18b7e2cf8eb01b73a36f5d114e5e0f.png[/img]
 This calligraphic version of the company logo will be available as a free upgrade pack in the future.

[h3][*] DLC with 45 additional asset cards [/h3]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/d95f7d88509de678ed6d6b1f81bb8a23f237c759.png[/img]
 The 'Travel and Train' DLC with 45 new asset cards and systems will be provided. We will inform you about the development of this DLC according to the schedule. [/list]

Feel free to send any bugs or comments through the [url=https://discord.gg/TcWszT7rMY]1897 Korea Discord channel[/url].
Thank you!

notes.title: Introducing 18Korea
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/03ef6dfcdee619e11c10b9555c81bab712f9686d.png[/img]


Hop aboard! It’s a big pleasure to introduce 18Korea.


 [b]18Korea[/b] is originally designed by our partner, physical board game company, [b]Art & Peace[/b]. 
And Sinkhole Studio Inc. presents the digital version of it which is able to enjoy 2~5 local & online multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/37f8d8bc1f4edc419dc76c08bba52ef17c5ae12e.png[/img]


[h1]What’s 18Korea?[/h1]

 18Korea is derived from the long-time loving genre ‘18xx’ which has its origins in the game ‘1829’ produced by Francis Tresham. 18xx is great series. But at the same time, it’s undeniable that it takes pretty [b]long time[/b] to play and [b]tricky[/b] to master. What we tried to solve the cons in the making of 18Korea can be summarized below:

[list]
[*]Shortened Playtime
 : We tried to shorten playtime from an average 18xx’s 5 hours to 2 hours. To do so, we mainly tried to prevent the later part of the game from being prolonged.

[*]High Replayability: You can meet 30 different asset cards in 18Korea that can be added to each company. Asset cards can help companies to raise more money, save some opportunities for later or hinder other players’ strategies. Asset cards are presented randomly at every game, so you can play plenty times of games with different conditions.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/7c963949909a029c972f08eac131cf0c3ffe33e5.png[/img]

[/list]

[h1]What’s special in 18Korea[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/5615af6050ea97db69ed02c51865b02ad3dcdf57.png[/img]

 As you can see in the title, 18Korea is based on the regions of the Korean Peninsula and its simplified version of railroad history. Since many 18xx series are based on European, we wanted to make what’s not shown in the previous series. So not only the map but the historical event we wanted to bring here.
 And of course, there's a reason that we are Korean too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41219738/4a88665965d0ff2b70eccc7ebecb0fbf205887fc.gif[/img]

 In the middle of the gameplay, the Korean War outbreaks. Since then, every city is destroyed and you cannot run companies in the North part of the map. So it’s your choice whether run companies in the North to make high revenue before the war or run in the South stably.



[h1]Update Plans & Playmode[/h1]

 18Korea presents two types of play for now. Local and online for 2~5 players. As long as the game and every player’s name are saved, you can stop the play and continue to play anytime.
 For now, there are not many various play modes like 'versus AI' or modes with special settings yet. We'd like to provide as many as playgrounds we can. But since we have to prepare the game well from the basics, so additional content will be added later on, step by step.



 It is significant that you guys play 18Korea with no inconvenience and plenty of fun. For that, we'll open Discord channel soon to communicate with you and gather any kind of opinion.

 We'll let you know any news or information you may want to know about the game.
See you soon! ːsteamhappyː
